summary: Defines a new sub-option of the CableLabs Client Configuration (CCC) DHCP option for conveying the network addresses of Key Distribution Center (KDC) servers. This lets cable devices learn where to find the servers that handle Kerberos-style key distribution. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: A new gadget needs to know where the key-handing office is. This adds a spot in the setup message that tells it the office's address.

questions: how do cable devices find a kdc
